title: Market Assumption Structural Record
description: Structural anchor for a market-assumption subject. Values, units, dates, scenarios, geography, and methodology belong exclusively in Facts.

id.description: Stable UUID used as the Market Assumption graph node and Fact relationship target.

schema_version.description: Version of this structural Market Assumption contract.

entity_type.description: Fixed collection discriminator used for deterministic typed references.

slug.description: Stable repository key; it does not encode an asserted assumption value.

display_name.description: Non-authoritative interface label; never the canonical assumption statement.

company_id.description: Optional structural scope edge to a Company node; null when not company-specific.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this structural graph node was created.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest permitted repository-administration update.

record_status.description: Repository-management state, not analytical validity or scenario status.

administrative_notes.description: Optional repository-management note containing no asserted market assumptions.
